decision: If 2 of 3 KPIs are met, we extend the pilot for another month.
If 3 of 3 are met, we extend to more advisors.
expectations: AE Digital maintains full creative control over creative, landing page designs, ad copy, ad image and offer
hypothesis: People actively conversing with ChatGPT for retirement, tax, estate, or investment questions are closer to taking action than passive social media users.

kpis.q: Are leads higher intent than Meta?

opportunity: We are wondering if ChatGPT ads can compress the amount of time a prospect stays in our funnel without spending more money.
problem: Using Meta ads to produce appointment requests can take a while for prospects to move all the way through the funnel.
setup: Phase 1: 1 advisor, 1 month commitment, $1k ad spend
Primary question for phase 1: Is it worth expanding to more advisors?
title: ChatGPT Ads pilot
